items.reported: Every state shows READINESS SNAPSHOT REQUIRES REPUBLISH even though the repo has published several times; the banner never says why a republish has not cleared it or what to do.
items.correctState: A published snapshot under the current derivation contract renders its cells; a quarantined one says what is on record (publish time, publisher, revision, contract), what it must become, the exact clearing command, and that the runner republishes unattended.
items.checkId: tests/admin-feedback-9-4.test.ts::ADM-1: REQUIRES_REPUBLISH carries the record's publish facts, the current contract and the clearing command
items.checkResult: GREEN — root cause: the three states' snapshots were published at 2026-09-04T08:35Z before the contract marker existed, and NOTHING schedules readiness:publish or owner:publish (no workflow, no scheduled task, not the runner). `pnpm readiness:publish` was run: az/nh/nj now at revision 2 with readiness/instrument-derived@1, and /readiness/az renders HELD locally. The runner now publishes the console after every cycle (scripts/pilot-runner.mts publishConsole), and the quarantine page names the record's facts and the clearing command.

items.reported: Selecting New Jersey takes about two seconds before the dashboard acknowledges the selection.
items.correctState: The chosen value shows the instant it is chosen with a status line saying what is loading; the server render is fast because a page read never replays the schema bootstrap.
items.checkId: tests/admin-feedback-9-4.test.ts::ADM-2: the console header navigates inside a transition, shows the choice at once, and the read path skips the schema bootstrap
items.checkResult: GREEN — ConsoleNav uses useTransition with an optimistic choice and a pending line; createPgRepositories gained skipBootstrap, used by both page read paths (nine sequential Neon round trips removed per request). Measured on the local production build with a minted session: the pending line appeared 26–65 ms after the choice and New Jersey rendered in 153–380 ms (dark and light).

items.reported: Pilot health AMBER with no grading scale shown, and three contract cards in instrument language; the owner could not tell what he was looking at.
items.correctState: The scale (green / amber / red / unknown) beside the grade; each card leads with one plain sentence for status, why and what happens next, with the instrument's own sentence behind a disclosure.
items.checkId: tests/admin-feedback-9-4.test.ts::ADM-3: a stale reader check reads as one plain sentence, and the scale names all four grades
items.checkResult: GREEN — lib/control-plane/plain-health.ts projects each contract into what/status/why/next; HealthScale renders under the grade; the instrument reason sits behind 'Instrument detail'. FRESHNESS now reads the measured shadow risk through one shared projection in owner:publish and pilot:health. IMAGE-verified on the local build in dark and light.

items.reported: 69 decision cards, every one an opaque id with 'not recorded on this row' under both headings and nothing that can be cleared or actioned.
items.correctState: Each card carries its title, priority, opened date and age, what is needed, why no machine can decide it, and its options; the owner picks an option or answers in his own words on the page; the decision is recorded at once and carried into the tracker by the next sync, which closes the row and opens the follow-up work.
items.checkId: tests/admin-feedback-9-4.test.ts::ADM-4: every open Needs-Sean row publishes a card carrying title, priority, opened date, age and the registry text
items.checkResult: GREEN — root cause: the publisher read docs/tracker-reconciliation.json alone, whose outcomes carry only rowId/kind/verdict/why; the card text lives in lib/tracker/registry.mjs and the row facts in docs/tracker-working.csv. lib/control-plane/decision-cards.ts makes the join the owner view already made; the republished snapshot carries 73 cards (67 decisions, 4 acknowledgements, 2 machine-checked walls) with 221 option buttons, verified on the local build. The decision route accepts an answer in the owner's own words; the outflow (owner:decisions:pull → tracker:move → owner:canonicalize, `pnpm decisions:apply`) is built and file-store proven in tests/owner-decisions-outflow.test.ts. Its first real application happens on the next `pnpm decisions:apply`.

items.reported: RUNNER SILENT in red with nothing to say whether the owner turned it off on purpose.
items.correctState: A recorded pause renders amber as 'Paused by you' with who, when and why; silence with no pause recorded says so and offers to record one; the runner idles on the pause, acknowledges it, and pnpm pilot:stop / pilot:disable / pilot:start record the pause and resume themselves.
items.checkId: tests/admin-feedback-9-4.test.ts::ADM-5: the owner's PAUSE_RUNNER turns the same silence amber, names who, when and why, and offers RESUME
items.checkResult: GREEN — the scheduled task 'WeThePeople Pilot Runner' is Disabled (owner's action, confirmed); no record of that existed. PAUSE_RUNNER/RESUME_RUNNER intents, runner-standing.ts, the runner's hold/acknowledge/pause-beat (tests/runner-owner-intents.test.ts, 15 green), and the pilot-task.ps1 hooks are built. The publisher no longer overwrites the runner heartbeat, which used to make a publish read as a beat. Verified on the local build: 'Silent — no pause recorded' with the record-a-pause control.

items.reported: By caller role, By model and Cache hit rate render as headings with no figures, only paragraphs about why each number is not recorded.
items.correctState: The numbers the control plane holds are shown: spend by role and by model with measured/unmeasured attempt counts, cache hit rate for the model workers, the lane share, and cost per verified record; a genuinely unmeasured figure is one short line.
items.checkId: tests/admin-feedback-9-4.test.ts::ADM-6: the ledger rolls up by role and by model with measured/unmeasured beside every row; the reader path is one short gap
items.checkResult: GREEN — the publisher never opened the cost ledger it wrote about. lib/control-plane/cost-panel.ts joins cp_log_costs, cp_attempts, the research metrics and the promotion pipeline; the republished snapshot carries $27.98 measured across 28 attempts (1,355 unmeasured, said so), 7 role rows, 2 model rows, the SCOUT cache rate, the lane share, and one-line gaps for the reader Ask path and cost per verified record (no record has reached VERIFIED). Also fixed while there: obligations by state (was empty), by provider (was five '0 of 0' rows keyed 0..4) and the debt denominator.

items.reported: Nothing on the page describes what the workers are doing; the owner expected a breakdown of hunters, detectives, auditors and verifiers.
items.correctState: Pilot health is organised around the fleet: for hunters, detectives, verifiers, auditors and engineers, what they are, what they are doing, how many are working, waiting and finished, and where they are deployed, read live from the control plane.
items.checkId: tests/admin-feedback-9-4.test.ts::ADM-7: the five groups cover the roles, with counts that carry denominators and a where-deployed derived from the WorkItem
items.checkResult: GREEN — lib/control-plane/fleet-view.ts maps the seven worker roles onto the owner's words (Engineers as their own line, never folded); every count is a Measured with its denominator and enters the page's own audit. IMAGE-verified on the local build: 8 attempts open, 1,605 on record, hunters deployed in Arizona 1,291 / New Hampshire 185 / New Jersey 25.

items.reported: The dashboard is read-only; the owner wants a Deploy fleet button that asks what to do and dispatches the fleet accordingly.
items.correctState: Deploy fleet opens a prompt; the words are recorded as a DISPATCH intent; the runner puts every registered unit matching the target first in both lanes and records what matched of what, or names the state it cannot reach; the dashboard lists each deployment with its outcome.
items.checkId: tests/admin-feedback-9-4.test.ts::ADM-8: units match by bounded state token or by term; a dispatch to an unenumerated state is honored by name
items.checkResult: GREEN — the control, the route, the target parser (dispatch-target.ts), the runner's honoring (freshness-shadow.mts, pilot-runner.mts; tests/runner-owner-intents.test.ts) and the deployments list are built. A dispatch may reorder registered work only; 'deep dive on Illinois' is honored today with 'Illinois is not enumerated yet' because no registry exists for it — enumerating a state is the owner's scope decision and is a Needs Sean row of its own.
